# Offline CFG layout

`dagre.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of [Dagre 1.1.5](https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre/tree/v1.1.5), including Graphlib. Both MIT license notices are retained alongside the bundle. Refresh with `node scripts/vendor_cfg.cjs` after installing the locked development dependencies. The viewer never fetches a graph library from a CDN.
